judge.rationale: The candidate stopped mid-implementation after completing only the first two facets of its plan. While `ajv` is added to `dependencies` and `ToolRegistry.register` compiles schemas at registration time, `ToolRegistry.execute` is completely untouched and never actually validates inputs or caches dynamic tool schemas. As a result, three of the four acceptance tests added in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts` fail. Furthermore, required updates to `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` are missing, and `.lore/dod.md` is left tracked in the diff.
